the average-current-control with six-step PWM in stationary (a, b, c) reference frame exhibits the lowest total-harmonic-distortion (THD) and the highest power factor (PF).

the average current control with three independent stationary controllers is the best choice for the implementation of the boost PFC rectifiers.

The main takeaway from our work is that

average-current control with six-step PWM in the stationary (a,b.c) reference frame is a simple and efficient method for controlling a three-phase six-switch PFC rectifier with high power factor and low THD of input currents.
the average current control with three independent current controllers exhibits the best THD of input currents, and the best power factor, whereas it has the lowest computation time.
the choice of control method depends on the application requirements.
